mapper.select: select g.*,n.employee_no,n.employee_name,n.dept_name from ( select r.employee_id,max(r.result_id) latest_id, count(*) generated_days, sum(r.work_day=1) work_days, sum(r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL')) settled_days, sum(r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') and r.missing_in=0 and r.missing_out=0 and r.work_minutes is not null) attended_days, sum(r.result_status='NORMAL') normal_days, sum(r.result_status='ABNORMAL') abnormal_days, sum(r.result_status='PENDING') pending_days, sum(r.result_status='REST') rest_days, sum(r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') and (r.missing_in=1 or r.missing_out=1)) missing_days, sum(r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') and r.late_minutes > 0) late_days, sum(r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') and r.early_minutes > 0) early_days, sum(case when r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') then r.late_minutes else 0 end) late_minutes, sum(case when r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') then r.early_minutes else 0 end) early_minutes, sum(case when r.work_day=1 then r.planned_work_minutes else 0 end) planned_work_minutes, sum(case when r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') and r.missing_in=0 and r.missing_out=0 and r.work_minutes is not null then r.planned_work_minutes else 0 end) settled_planned_minutes, sum(case when r.result_status in ('NORMAL','ABNORMAL') and r.missing_in=0 and r.missing_out=0 then coalesce(r.work_minutes,0) else 0 end) work_minutes, sum(r.work_day=1 and (r.result_status='PENDING' or r.missing_in=1 or r.missing_out=1 or r.work_minutes is null)) unknown_work_days from att_daily_result r where r.attendance_date >= #{beginDate} and r.attendance_date <= #{endDate} and r.site_id=#{siteId} and r.dept_id=#{deptId} and r.user_id=#{userId} and r.employee_no like concat('%',#{employeeNo},'%') and r.employee_name like concat('%',#{employeeName},'%') ${params.dataScope} group by r.employee_id ) g join att_daily_result n on n.result_id=g.latest_id order by g.employee_id
